findings.evidence: The declarations occur under `namespace TauCeti` at lines 50–99, while `typeD` is defined by Mathlib in `Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/Classical.lean` under `namespace LieAlgebra.Orthogonal`; the rubric requires declarations whose first explicit argument has an existing Mathlib type to use that type's namespace.
findings.fix: Move all three into `LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.typeD` and name them `apply_inr_inr`, `apply_inl_inr`, and `apply_inr_inl`; update their uses accordingly.
findings.issue: `typeD_apply_inr_inr`, `typeD_apply_inl_inr` (line 73), and `typeD_apply_inr_inl` (line 86) take `A : LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.typeD ι K` first but live in `TauCeti`, preventing the prescribed dot-notation API.

summary: The three new structural lemmas are placed outside the namespace of the existing Mathlib type that is their first explicit argument.
